records.journey: Create and retry a manually numbered invoice
records.missingBoundary: Entered invoice number through UI request to stored invoice and uniqueness rollback

reproduction.defect: On a disposable checkout of the base revision, copy the permanent test from the fix revision and execute it against the unchanged manual invoice action.

before.assertion: The action allocates an automatic number instead of persisting the supplied trimmed number.

after.assertion: Custom number persists, blank input still allocates, duplicate-number retry returns INVOICE_NUMBER_CONFLICT and rolls back with identical invoice, charge and transaction rows.

limits: The before action test uses a database mock; the after duplicate retry additionally uses real migrated PostgreSQL.
